Role: Solutions Architect
Company: Smartsheet

<job_posting>
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions sma

requirements.text: 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and education
Working experience with two or more of our primary languages (.Net, NodeJS, Python, Java, Ruby)
Full-stack development skills, with the ability to independently design, build, and ship production-quality applications — not just configure existing tools
Familiarity with AI/LLM technologies and experience integrating them into applications via APIs
Working knowledge of prompt engineering and AI agent design patterns, with curiosity for applying AI to solve real business problems
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, with comfort integrating them into a daily engineering workflow
Strong communication skills (written, verbal, presentation), with the ability to explain technical subjects to non-technical end user personnel in large enterprises
Proven ability to drive projects from concept through completion with minimal guidance
Comfort operating with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-changing environments where requirements evolve in real time
Experience rapidly prototyping and iterating on solutions based on direct, hands-on customer feedback
Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
Knowledge of data integration and experience integrating SaaS applications with different business systems (ETL, CRM, business analytics, reporting, etc.)
Willing to travel periodically (up to 15%) based on customer and business need
Bachelor's in MIS, CIS, CS preferred but not required
